a: Shrink-to-fit scales every run size but not its stroke width, so a shrunk outlined text keeps its full-size outline
A covered code point in a right-to-left shaped cluster reads as left-to-right, so a mirrorable one is drawn a second time
A code point the bidi engine removed reports level 0 inside a right-to-left line, so the hyphen a wrapped RTL line draws hit-tests the wrong way
b: The pooled `Line` objects keep the previous layout's entries, defeating `POOL_MAX`'s bound
Positions the bidi engine removed (X9) get level 0, not the level of the character they are placed beside
`JOINED_ENDS` grows to the longest text ever measured and never shrinks, unlike every sibling scratch, which caps at 2^16
